meta.name: high-perf-browser
meta.description: Optimize web performance through network protocols, resource loading, and browser rendering internals. Use when the user mentions "my site is slow", "Core Web Vitals", "HTTP/2 or HTTP/3", "resource hints", "network latency", "render blocking", "TCP/TLS optimization", "service worker", "Cache-Control or caching strategy", or "critical rendering path". Also trigger when diagnosing slow page loads, optimizing time to first byte, choosing between WebSocket and SSE, or reducing bundle sizes. For UI visual performance, see refactoring-ui. For font loading, see web-typography.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并优化网站加载速度与核心指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站加载慢或核心网页指标不达标
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and optimize website loading speed and Core Web Vitals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website is slow or Core Web Vitals are poor

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析网页加载慢的原因，给出网络协议、资源加载、缓存策略等优化建议，并报告 Core Web Vitals 得分。
howto.when: 当你提到“网站慢”、“Core Web Vitals”、“HTTP/2”等关键词，或要求诊断页面加载、优化首字节时间时触发。

say.text: 我的网站加载很慢，帮我诊断一下。
say.note: Claude 会分析可能的原因并给出优化步骤。

say.text: 如何优化 Core Web Vitals 中的 LCP？
say.note: Claude 会解释 LCP 优化方法，如预加载关键元素。

say.text: HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3 有什么区别？
say.note: Claude 会对比协议差异并给出迁移建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes slow page loads and provides optimization advice on network protocols, resource loading, caching strategies, and reports Core Web Vitals scores.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "my site is slow", "Core Web Vitals", "HTTP/2", or ask to diagnose page load, optimize TTFB, etc.

say_en.text: My website is slow, help me diagnose it.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze possible causes and suggest optimizations.

say_en.text: How to optimize LCP for Core Web Vitals?
say_en.note: Claude explains LCP optimization, like preloading critical elements.

say_en.text: What's the difference between HTTP/2 and HTTP/3?
say_en.note: Claude compares protocols and gives migration advice.
